name: Polynomial.deriv_gaussian_eq_hermite_mul_gaussian
type: (n : ℕ) → (x : ℝ) → deriv^[n] (fun y => Real.exp (-(y ^ 2 / 2))) x = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.hermite n) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))
provides: The probabilists’ Hermite polynomial evaluated over the reals is the signed polynomial factor in every iterated derivative of exp(-x^2/2).
